text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — SmartRouting latency spike detected in eu-west, affecting tiered routing policy. Alert ID SR-20260315-01. Page oncall-sre (lee).

maria: saw increased p95 token latency ~2x on model-gpu-4 in eu-west, started ~02:07 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts on completions API.

sam: I'm up. Can we do a quick tier-smoothing — lower max concurrency for 'free' and 'starter' tiers and steer traffic to region fallback us-east? Will push policy change.

lee: taking oncall. I'll coordinate mitigations. Any customer-facing impact known?

support-bot: 9 customer incidents open, 3 with timeouts, 6 degraded responses. Top impacted orgs: acme.inc, shoply, finapi. ETA to mitigate unknown.

sam: applying smoothed routing policy now — command:
```
POST /admin/routing/v1/policies/smoothed-deploy
{
  "match": {"region": "eu-west", "tier": ["free","starter"]},
  "action": {"steer_to": "us-east", "weight": 0.85, "max_concurrency": 8}
}
```

sam: rolled out to 3 nodes, enabling gradual shift 10%->50% over 5m.

kai: monitoring metrics — p95 in eu-west dropped from 1100ms to 650ms after 20% steer. Error counts decreasing.

maria: customer callback request from finapi — they need note for RCA and whether quota changes applied. Any temporary quota bumps?

lee: no permanent quota changes yet. Temporary caps: throttle new session creation for free tier to 0.5 qps, starter to 1.5 qps. Notifying CS.

product-ops: leaving a pinned note for CS: "We are steering low-priority traffic to us-east and temporarily lowering concurrency for free/starter tiers. No model changes."

sam: added fallback: disable long-context session warming for affected tiers to reduce KV-insert load.

kai: system metrics steady. Keeping on gradual roll for 10m. I'll post again at +10m.

lee: handing off to sam for overnight monitoring. I'm on standby until 03:30 UTC. sam you have the page.

sam: ack — taking over. If latency goes above 900ms in eu-west for 5m we'll escalate to infra and consider regional capacity spinup. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident SR-20260315-01 status updated: mitigation in progress — steering applied. Next update scheduled +10m.
